aboutInfo.name: Cristian Florez
aboutInfo.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
aboutInfo.headline: Full-stack engineer building fast, reliable platforms for government and enterprise — now shipped with AI-native workflows.
aboutInfo.bio: For 4+ years I've delivered mission-critical web platforms for Colombia's Supreme Court and one of the country's largest banks. I work across the stack — Angular, React, Node.js and .NET, from database schema to cloud deployment — and I measure success in latency, uptime and hours saved. Today I pair that foundation with AI engineering: Claude Code, Gemini and agentic workflows driven by spec-driven development.
aboutInfo.focus: Scalable architecture, performance and AI-assisted delivery
